question.text: What will the first reported revenues after September 2026 be for the following companies? (Apple)
question.resolution_criteria:
Each subquestion will resolve as the revenue reported in each company's first official quarterly earnings release after September 30, 2026. This is expected to be released no earlier than:

* Apple Q4 FY2026 November 2, 2026 ([source](https://finance.yahoo.com/calendar/earnings?symbol=AAPL))
* AMD Q3 FY2026 November 3, 2026 ([source](https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/AMD/earnings))
* Amazon Q3 FY2026 October 29, 2026 ([source](https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/AMZN/earnings))
* Meta Q3 FY2026 October 21, 2026 ([source](https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/META/earnings))
* Microsoft Q1 FY 2027 October 28, 2026 ([source](https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/MSFT/earnings))
* Nvidia Q3 FY 2027 November 25, 2026 ([source](https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/NVDA/earnings))
* SpaceX Q3 FY 2026 October 20, 2026 ([source](https://www.wallstreethorizon.com/spacex-earnings-calendar))
* Tesla Q3 FY 2026 October 21, 2026 ([source](https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/TSLA/earnings))

The earnings reports are typically released on the respective companies' investor relations websites and filed with the [U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC)](https://www.sec.gov/search-filings) as a Form 8-K.
question.fine_print:
Only the initially reported figures encompassing the entirety of the previous quarter will be considered. Any subsequent revisions, corrections, or restatements will not affect resolution. 

If a company does not publicly report earnings after September 30, 2026 and before January 1, 2027 or if it ceases to operate as a standalone public company, that specific subquestion will be **annulled**.

## Apple Q4 FY2026 revenue (quarter ended about Sept 26, 2026): research notes

**Summary:** Apple reports on Nov 2. Its own guidance of 9% to 11% growth works out to roughly $111.7B to $113.7B. Consensus is about $113.0B to $113.4B, and Apple has usually landed in the upper half of its range or above it.

### 1. Resolution source
- 2026-10-06/07: Apple's Investor Relations page lists the FY26 Q4 results for Monday, Nov 2, 2026, after the close. The release comes out at 1:30pm PT and the call is at 2:00pm PT. It will be the first call led by CEO John Ternus, with CFO Kevan Parekh. [MacRumors](https://macrumors.com/2026/10/06/apple-q4-2026-earnings-nov-2), [MacDailyNews](https://macdailynews.com/2026/10/07/apple-to-report-q426-earnings-on-monday-november-2nd/)
- The number that decides the question will be "Total net sales" in the 8-K Exhibit 99.1 press release. Last quarter's release is [here](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000320193/000032019326000018/a8-kex991q3202606272026.htm). The year-ago quarter (Q4 FY25) was $102,466M.
- I did not fetch the Yahoo earnings calendar, but the Nov 2 date is confirmed by several outlets. One aggregator listed Oct 29 as an unconfirmed estimate. Oct 29 is actually the date of Apple's product event, not its earnings.

### 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the question yet, because results are not out. The fiscal quarter itself has already ended, around Sept 26. Apple does not pre-announce.

### 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-10-27: Apple holds a "Pro and tell" product event on Oct 29, with new MacBooks and an iMac expected. It does not affect revenue for the quarter that already closed. [UDN](https://udn.com/news/story/7255/9840606)
- 2026-10-26: Zacks puts consensus revenue at $112.95B (+10.2% YoY) and EPS at $2.00. It notes Apple beat EPS in each of the last 4 quarters, most recently by +1.60%. [Zacks](https://www.zacks.com/stock/news/3014919/apple-aapl-earnings-expected-to-grow-should-you-buy)
- 2026-10-26: 24/7 Wall St. puts consensus at $113.36B (+10.6%). It says iPhone, Mac and iPad are all supply constrained and cites Cook's description of memory pricing as a "100-year flood." [24/7 Wall St.](https://247wallst.com/investing/2026/10/26/apples-5-trillion-dilemma-3-reasons-earnings-could-spark-a-breakout-on-nov-2-or-a-meltdown)
- 2026-10-23: The iPhone Duo foldable ($1,999) launched with very strong demand, but its launch date puts it in the December quarter, not this one. [Motley Fool](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/10/26/1-reason-apple-could-outperform-in-2027/), [search summary of MacDailyNews/others](https://macdailynews.com/2026/07/31/analysts-split-on-apple-after-strong-q3-beat-overshadowed-by-soft-q4-guidance/)
- 2026-07-30: Apple's guidance for the September quarter (CFO Parekh):
  - Total revenue growth of 9% to 11% YoY.
  - FX is a sequential headwind of about 2.5 percentage points.
  - iPhone growth in the "mid-teens."
  - Services growth "largely similar" to the June quarter, which was +12% at about $30.7B.
  - The impact of supply constraints is expected to "increase significantly sequentially."
  - Analysts had modeled about 12% growth (around $115B), so the guide came in below expectations.
  
  [Six Colors transcript](https://sixcolors.com/post/2026/07/one-last-time-this-is-tim-transcript-of-apples-q3-2026-financial-call/), [MacRumors](https://macrumors.com/2026/07/30/apple-iphone-mac-ipad-supply-constraints)
- Applying the guide to $102.466B gives: 9% = $111.69B, 10% = $112.71B, 11% = $113.74B.

### 4. Base rates (guided growth vs. actual)

| Quarter | Guidance | Actual | Result vs. guide |
|---|---|---|---|
| Q4 FY25 | 5% to 8% | +8.0% ($102.47B) | At the top |
| Q1 FY26 | 10% to 12% | +15.7% ($143.76B) | About 3.7 percentage points above the top |
| Q2 FY26 | 13% to 16% | +16.6% ($111.18B) | About 0.6 percentage points above the top |
| Q3 FY26 | 14% to 17% | +16.4% ($109.42B) | Above the midpoint, below the top |

- Sources: Q2 FY26 guidance from the [Yahoo Q1 call highlights](https://finance.yahoo.com/news/apple-q1-earnings-call-highlights-235531571.html); Q3 FY26 guidance from [9to5Mac](https://9to5mac.com/2026/04/30/apple-shares-june-quarter-guidance-with-14-to-17-revenue-growth-outlook/).
- I took the Q4 FY25 (5% to 8%) and Q1 FY26 (10% to 12%) guidance ranges from memory and did not verify them in this session.
- Pattern: actual revenue has come in at or above the guided midpoint in all four recent quarters. It landed at or above the top end in 3 of 4, by about 0 to 3.7 percentage points.
- Applying that pattern to this quarter's guide gives roughly $113.0B (midpoint +0.3 percentage points) to about $117B (a Q1-style beat). The more typical outcome, top end to top +0.6 percentage points, is about $113.7B to $114.4B.
- Sequential check: Q4 revenue was above Q3 in each of the last two years ($94.93B vs $85.78B in FY24; $102.47B vs $94.04B in FY25). This year Q3 was $109.42B.
- Caveat: Apple says this quarter is supply constrained, which limits how far revenue can beat. It also guided below consensus.

### 5. Other forecasts
- Consensus revenue: $112.95B (Zacks) and $113.36B (24/7 Wall St.).
- On Polymarket, segment markets as of 2026-10-28 put the iPhone median near $57B (>$57B at 0.485; >$55.5B at 0.78).
  - Arithmetic check on mid-teens iPhone growth: Q4 FY25 iPhone revenue was about $49.0B (from memory), so +15% is about $56.4B.
  - Services is probably about $31.5B to $32B (>$31.5B at 0.83; >$32B at 0.33). Note that the >$31B price (0.715) is lower than the >$31.5B price, an inconsistency in the market.
  - Mac's median is about $10.2B. The prices are non-monotonic (>$9B at 0.63 vs >$9.5B at 0.865), which suggests the market is thin.
- Polymarket "Apple beat quarterly earnings" (EPS): 0.815 Yes.
- I found no Polymarket, Kalshi or Manifold market on Apple's total revenue. The Kalshi markets supplied with the question (earnings-call words, headcount) are not relevant to revenue.
- Adding up the segment medians (iPhone about 57 + Services about 31.7 + Mac about 10.2 + iPad and Wearables, which I did not find, typically about 7 + about 9) gives roughly $114B to $115B. This is my rough arithmetic, not a market price.

### 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- 2026-10-29: Apple's product event. It has no direct effect on the quarter's revenue, though it may shift sentiment.
- 2026-10-29: Amazon reports, which is market context only.
- 2026-11-02, about 20:30 UTC: Apple's earnings release, which resolves the question. Forecasts close at 10:00 UTC that day, before the release.
- I found no reports of a pre-announcement, guidance change or 8-K update since July 30.

(b) **Latest known value:** Q3 FY26, the quarter ended June 2026 and reported July 30, 2026, had total net sales of $109,417M. The year-ago comparison quarter, Q4 FY25, was $102,466M.

(e) **Historical variation:** The quarter has already closed, so the uncertainty is about the outcome relative to guidance. Results have come in between 0 and about 4 percentage points of growth above the guided midpoint, which is roughly $0B to $4B here. Supply constraints this quarter make a large beat less likely.

(f) **Expert and market expectations:**

- Polymarket segment medians are iPhone about $57B, Services about $31.7B and Mac about $10.2B. Together with typical iPad and Wearables figures, they imply roughly $114B to $115B.
- The EPS beat probability is 0.815.

(g) **Unexpected scenarios:**
